name: Largeleaf pennywort
desc: Largeleaf pennywort (Hydrocotyle bonariensis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hydrocotyle bonariensis, the largeleaf pennywort, once a member of the family Apiaceae, now in the family Araliaceae and of the genus Hydrocotyle, is a hairless and creeping perennial.
